env.world: Independent multinomial sampling from an observable law and its Gaussian asymptotics. For \(n\ge1\) the records \(O_1,\ldots,O_n\) are independent and identically distributed with law \(p\in\mathfrak O\); \(N=(N_o)_{o\in\mathcal O}\), \(N_o=\sum_{i\le n}\mathbf 1\{O_i=o\}\), and \(\widehat p=N/n\). The projected law is \(\widetilde p=\Pi_{\mathfrak O}(\widehat p)\) and the plug-in endpoint estimator is \(\widehat\theta=(\widehat L,\widehat U)=\theta(\widetilde p)\). The multinomial covariance is \(\Sigma_p=\operatorname{diag}(p)-pp^{\top}\) with centered Gaussian limit \(G_p\sim\mathcal N(0,\Sigma_p)\) on \(\mathbb R^{|\mathcal O|}\). Inference is at nominal error \(\alpha\in(0,1)\): marginal intervals \([\ell_o(N_o),u_o(N_o)]\) at level \(\alpha/|\mathcal O|\), the simultaneous box \(\mathcal C_{n,\alpha}=\{v\in\Delta_{|\mathcal O|-1}:\ell_o(N_o)\le v_o\le u_o(N_o)\}\), and the whole-identified-set interval \(\mathcal I_{n,\alpha}\), equal to \(\{h_e^{\top}v:v\in\Delta_{\mathrm{SLCC}},Bv\in\mathcal C_{n,\alpha}\}\) when \(\mathcal C_{n,\alpha}\cap\mathfrak O\neq\varnothing\) and \([0,1]\) otherwise.
